subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customers, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale with up to 50% off on selected items. Don't miss out on this limited-time opportunity to upgrade your wardrobe for the season. From trendy dresses to stylish accessories, we have something for everyone. Visit our store or shop online to explore the hottest deals of the season. Hurry, stocks are limited! Happy shopping! Warm regards, The Fashion Team
